feature: V4.1 Scoped Tools — retrieval + V3-style examination tools restricted to CandidateSet
problem: V4 harness (metadata-only, no diff access) achieved Hit@5=0.062 vs V3's 0.50. The proposed hybrid approach (raw repo access via SDK) violates temporal bound, oracle isolation, and llm_reasons_scripts_retrieve invariants.
proposed_solution: Keep V4 deterministic retrieval (prepare_investigation). Replace the state machine harness with a V3-style multi-turn agentic loop using scoped tools: get_commit_diff, get_commit_message, get_blame, get_file_at_commit — all restricted to CandidateSet SHAs and enforced by GitContextProvider temporal bound.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: build_scoped_tools(git, candidate_set) rejects commit SHAs not in CandidateSet with clear error message
AC2: build_scoped_tools() registers only examination tools (get_commit_diff, get_commit_message, get_blame, get_file_at_commit) — no search tools
AC3: ScopedInvestigator produces suspects within budget (<=15 tool calls, <=8 turns)
AC4: run_scoped_investigation() wires retrieval + scoped investigator end-to-end, returns V4InvestigationResult-compatible output
AC5: On 3 test cases (CASSANDRA-7570, SPARK-2583, SPARK-19033), produces parseable suspects with >=1 suspect per case
AC6: All existing 372 tests + new tests pass with zero regressions
AC7: All tool calls go through GitContextProvider, temporal bound enforced
edge_cases: EC1: LLM requests SHA not in CandidateSet — tool returns error, investigation continues
EC2: LLM outputs suspects on first turn before any tool calls — rejected, must examine at least 1 diff
EC3: CandidateSet is empty — ScopedInvestigator returns empty suspects without crashing
EC4: LLM outputs no tool calls and no suspects — nudged to use tools, max retries before degraded exit
verification_method: pytest sensors (unit + integration tests), then run_scoped_eval.py on 3 cases to verify suspect parsing and Hit@5 > 0
